content_md: Humans can’t even align with each other (which is why we have war, politics, and conflict). And, given the insights of Freud, Minsky, and Ainslie, we realize that we can’t even achieve alignment within ourselves, because we are a mess of conflicting desires – not just accidentally, but constitutively.
